articles.title: 25th ANNIVERSARY (SILVER JUBILEE PROGRAM) ROTARY CLUB OF KASTHAMANDAP
articles.excerpt: 25th Anniversary Silver Jubilee Program of Rotary Club of Kasthamandap was held on 17th January 2026 (2082-10-03) at Radisson Hotel, Lazimpat Kathmandu. Chief Guest of the program was District Governor 3292 Rtn. Binod Koirala. The program was attended by Eight Japanese Rotarians…
paragraphs: 25th Anniversary Silver Jubilee Program of Rotary Club of Kasthamandap was held on 17th January 2026 (2082-10-03) at Radisson Hotel, Lazimpat Kathmandu. Chief Guest of the program was District Governor 3292 Rtn. Binod Koirala. The program was attended by Eight Japanese Rotarians from three different clubs of Japan (Shimodate, Hitachi, Tsuchiura), District 3292 officials, AG, Charter President, President, Secretary, PE, Past Presidents, club members and spouse as well as Rotarians from other Rotary clubs and guests including Miss Nepal World and Miss Nepal Earth.

The Program was started with National Anthem & Rotary Song and welcome Address by Program Convener of the Ceremony PP Rtn. Pradeep Kumar Shrestha. Secretary Rtn. Sanjay Dudhani gave slide presentation of 25 years of Journey of RC Kasthamandap.

DG Rtn. Binod Koirala handed over Memento to the Charter President, Past Presidents, Club Members, Rotaract Club and Interact Club to recognize their contributions to the society through Rotary over 25 years of Self-Above-Service.

On the occasion Japanese delegates PDG Rtn. Shoichi Fujii RID 2820 and RRFC, PDG Rtn. Kazuo Arai delivered the speech and gave presentation highlighting the sister relations and major activities carried out in collaborations with the clubs.

Club President Rtn. Prof. Dr. Manohar Lal Shrestha and delegates handed over the scholarship award Rs. 2,50,000 to 25 blind students through Pawan Ghimire, Member Secretary, NAWB which was contributed by RCK Members and also NRs. 50,000 to NAWB representative for Brail Calendar Printing as part of WCS Project 2026.

PDG Rtn. Kiran Lal Shrestha, Assistant Zonal Action Champion of RI for 2026-2029 handed over Automated External Defibrillator (AED) machine to RCK Member Dr. Rudra Marasani for National Trauma Center as Dr Marasini is the Chief Medical Superintendent of the center.

Speech was also delivered by President Rtn. Prof. Dr. Manohar Lal Shrestha, Chief Guest DG Rtn. Binod Koirala, Charter President Rtn. Gajendra Bahadur Shrestha and vote of thanks by President Elect Rtn. Shailesh Vaidya
Meeting ended by MC Bijay Karmacharya after 25th Anniversary Cake Cutting ceremony together with Miss Nepal World Luna and Miss Nepal Earth Sony.
Program adjourned by President Prof. Dr. Manohar Lal Shrestha with the request to join fellowship dinner.
articles.bodyText:
25th Anniversary Silver Jubilee Program of Rotary Club of Kasthamandap was held on 17th January 2026 (2082-10-03) at Radisson Hotel, Lazimpat Kathmandu. Chief Guest of the program was District Governor 3292 Rtn. Binod Koirala. The program was attended by Eight Japanese Rotarians from three different clubs of Japan (Shimodate, Hitachi, Tsuchiura), District 3292 officials, AG, Charter President, President, Secretary, PE, Past Presidents, club members and spouse as well as Rotarians from other Rotary clubs and guests including Miss Nepal World and Miss Nepal Earth.
The Program was started with National Anthem & Rotary Song and welcome Address by Program Convener of the Ceremony PP Rtn. Pradeep Kumar Shrestha. Secretary Rtn. Sanjay Dudhani gave slide presentation of 25 years of Journey of RC Kasthamandap.
DG Rtn. Binod Koirala handed over Memento to the Charter President, Past Presidents, Club Members, Rotaract Club and Interact Club to recognize their contributions to the society through Rotary over 25 years of Self-Above-Service.
On the occasion Japanese delegates PDG Rtn. Shoichi Fujii RID 2820 and RRFC, PDG Rtn. Kazuo Arai delivered the speech and gave presentation highlighting the sister relations and major activities carried out in collaborations with the clubs.
Club President Rtn. Prof. Dr. Manohar Lal Shrestha and delegates handed over the scholarship award Rs. 2,50,000 to 25 blind students through Pawan Ghimire, Member Secretary, NAWB which was contributed by RCK Members and also NRs. 50,000 to NAWB representative for Brail Calendar Printing as part of WCS Project 2026.
PDG Rtn. Kiran Lal Shrestha, Assistant Zonal Action Champion of RI for 2026-2029 handed over Automated External Defibrillator (AED) machine to RCK Member Dr. Rudra Marasani for National Trauma Center as Dr Marasini is the Chief Medical Superintendent of the center.
Speech was also delivered by President Rtn. Prof. Dr. Manohar Lal Shrestha, Chief Guest DG Rtn. Binod Koirala, Charter President Rtn. Gajendra Bahadur Shrestha and vote of thanks by President Elect Rtn. Shailesh Vaidya
Meeting ended by MC Bijay Karmacharya after 25th Anniversary Cake Cutting ceremony together with Miss Nepal World Luna and Miss Nepal Earth Sony.
Program adjourned by President Prof. Dr. Manohar Lal Shrestha with the request to join fellowship dinner.

articles.title: District Governor Jitendra B. Rajbhandary official visit to RC Kasthamandap
articles.excerpt: On August 26, 2022, District Governor Rtn Jitendra B. Rajbhandary paid an official visit to Rotary Club Kasthamandap (RCK) in accordance with Rotary International rules, accompanied by Assistant Governor Samjhana Pokhrel Shah and District Secretary Amit…
paragraphs: On August 26, 2022, District Governor Rtn Jitendra B. Rajbhandary paid an official visit to Rotary Club Kasthamandap (RCK) in accordance with Rotary International rules, accompanied by Assistant Governor Samjhana Pokhrel Shah and District Secretary Amit Giri.

Upon arrival, DG Jitendra and his team were warmly welcomed by RCK President Rtn Yadab Lal Pradhan, Secretary Raj Kumar Gurung, Immediate Past President Nepal Bhushan Chand, Club President Gajendra B. Shrestha, past presidents, and members.

During the visit, DG Jitendra conducted the club’s 3rd Club Assembly and requested all chairs to present the club’s plan and program. The Club Administration Chair, Membership Chair, Youth Chair, Public Image Chair, and Service Chair presented the club’s annual plan and programs for the year 2022-23. DG Jitendra appreciated and applauded various projects of RC Kasthamandap which will be very beneficial to the community. President Yadab showed a multimedia presentation of all the completed activities in July-August 2022 by RC Kasthamandap.

DG visits are considered one of the most important events in Rotary. The District Governor visits every club mainly for a health checkup. In his own words, our club’s health is very good and does not require any medicines. Instead, he wants us to share our success stories in various areas. He was amazed to see our friendship and bonding as well as how we enjoyed our fellowship and meetings. We have been asked to share the reason for our very successful membership retention as well as our capability in doing so many service projects. He mentioned that he is very happy to see various service projects in all seven areas of focus of Rotary.

RCK having completed one of the most difficult TEACH projects in six schools of Suryabinayak has undertaken another GG for four schools for TEACH Project at Nagarjun, which is praiseworthy. Our members’ contribution in “Bucket of Hope Project” together with Rotaract’s activities was appreciated. DG applauded when he learned about the 2.6 million Rupees raised by club members during the Covid crisis within a week, most of which was in one virtual zoom meeting.

Our Dharan/Dhankuta Project continuation for 16 years was another example of service-above-self to serve disabled and blind children. DG also gave good remarks on our highest contribution for 150 wheelchairs in July 2022 which was handed over to President Yadab by RI IPP Shekhar Mehata.
During the club meeting, President Yadab also handed over cheques to DG for RI Annual Fund for 100% contributing club, PHS, MPHF and also PHF to maintain the status of 100% PHF club.
DG presented and shared his Rotary knowledge with valuable suggestions on how we can maintain our club’s vibrancy and areas of improvement to further grow.

Club President Rtn Yadab Pradhan said to DG, “Your inspiring words, appreciations, sharing Rotary knowledge, and all your valuable suggestions are highly appreciated by all of us. It will surely help us make RC Kasthamandap more vibrant. We have taken all your guidance positively as a mantra to move forward in the coming days. We are very impressed with your extensive knowledge of Rotary and dedication to helping disadvantaged people during your Rotary journey. With your simplicity and friendliness, you have won our hearts, and your encouragement has motivated us to take more challenges in serving society.”
The meeting concluded with a buffet breakfast and a special meeting with DG, AG, DS, President with Rotaract President and team.

articles.title: 22nd Installation and Charter Night of Rotary Club of Kasthamandap
articles.excerpt: The Rotary Club of Kasthamandap is delighted to announce the successful completion of its 22nd Installation Ceremony and Charter Night on 27th June 2023, hosted at Hotel Shankar in Lazimpat. At the event, Rtn. Yadab Lal Pradhan, the outgoing President, gracefully handed over the…
paragraphs: The Rotary Club of Kasthamandap is delighted to announce the successful completion of its 22nd Installation Ceremony and Charter Night on 27th June 2023, hosted at Hotel Shankar in Lazimpat. At the event, Rtn. Yadab Lal Pradhan, the outgoing President, gracefully handed over the leadership responsibilities to Rtn. Om Rajbhandary, the incoming President.

The ceremony was honored by esteemed guests including Chief Guest DGE Rtn Rajendra Prasad Dhoju, PDG Tirtha Man Shakya, PDG Rtn Jaya Rajya Laxmi Shah, AG Samjhana Pokharel, AGE Rtn Saroj Shrestha and Miss Nepal World 2023 Miss Srichchha Pradhan. Distinguished district officials, Rotarians, Rotaractors, Interactors, and community leaders also attended the event, making it a truly memorable and inspiring occasion.

Rtn. Yadab Lal Pradhan took the opportunity to express his heartfelt appreciation to the team and celebrate the remarkable achievements accomplished during his tenure. His leadership, hard work, and unwavering commitment have set a commendable example for the entire club. A standing ovation was given to outgoing President Rtn Yadab Lal Pradhan for the successful tenure as proposed by Charter President Rtn Gajendra B Shrestha. A token of appreciation was presented to Rtn Yadab lal Pradhan and first lady Rtn Prabha Rajbhandary Pradhan to acknowledge their efforts and hard work shown during the tenure. Additionally, the club members generously donated funds to various organizations as part of their ongoing efforts to make a positive impact in the community. The donors were acknowledged for their contribution to various endowment funds.

Incoming President Rtn. Om Rajbhandary expressed his gratitude for the trust placed in him and shared his vision for the upcoming Rotary Year. He emphasized the club’s commitment to empower lives, uplift communities, and also to work towards the district theme, “Light of Hope,” aligning with Rotary International’s theme “Create Hope in the World” for the Rotary Year 2023-24. Rtn. Rajbhandary’s vision inspires confidence and unity among the members as they embark on this new chapter of service.

The ceremony concluded with a heartwarming fellowship among the attendees. Rotarians, Rotaractors, Interactors, and guests had the opportunity to connect, share stories, and strengthen the bonds of friendship. The spirit of fellowship among Rotarians serves as a powerful reminder of the enduring bonds that unite them in their commitment to Service above self.

articles.title: WCS conducted by RC Shimodate, RC Hitachi Japan and RC Kasthamandap
articles.excerpt: On 11th April, 2023 three clubs from RC Shimodate, RC Hitachi and RC Kasthamandap organized Rotary World Community Services (WCS) by visiting three different schools namely Shree Ganesh Primary School Namobuddha, Dapcha, Shree Janaudaya School Bhainsepati and Shramik School,…
paragraphs: On 11th April, 2023 three clubs from RC Shimodate, RC Hitachi and RC Kasthamandap organized Rotary World Community Services (WCS) by visiting three different schools namely Shree Ganesh Primary School Namobuddha, Dapcha, Shree Janaudaya School Bhainsepati and Shramik School, Pulchowk. On the occasion, PDG Soichi Fujii, PDG Kazou Arai, Past president Tomohisa Ono RC Hitachi, and President elect Kenichi Miyata RC Shimodate all from RID 2820 Japan participated along with President Yadab Pradhan RC Kasthamandap, CP Gajendra B. Shrestha, IPP Nepal Bhusan Chand and other past presidents and members to distribute stationaries, school bags, sport materials and other school necessities. During the program they also handed over cheque of Rs. 60,000 to the president of Nepal Associations for Welfare of Blind (NAWB) to support the printing of brail calendar of BS 2080.

RC Kasthamandap has been supporting various schools in Nepal since last 20 years in collaborations with RC Shimodate. Later RC Hitachi also joined the collaborations since last 5 years. The total support amount for the program was more than six lakhs.

articles.title: Women’s day celebration at RC Kasthamandap
articles.excerpt: International Women’s Day is celebrated on March 8th every year in many countries around the world. It is a day to honor the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women. The day also serves as a reminder of the ongoing struggle for gender equality and women’s…
paragraphs: International Women’s Day is celebrated on March 8th every year in many countries around the world. It is a day to honor the social, economic, cultural, and political achievements of women. The day also serves as a reminder of the ongoing struggle for gender equality and women’s rights.

On this occasion RC Kasthamandap felicitated four women of our society who have contributed a lot to the people and communities in Nepal. They were all introduced with brief biodata and given floor to share their heart touching life time experiences and hard work they had to go through to be successful to the audition during the weekly Friday meeting on 10th March, 2023 at Radisson Hotel. President Yadab Pradhan and past presidents welcomed all four women namely Rtn Dr. Priti Bhusal-Mt. Everest climber of RCK, Mrs. Gyanu Shova Tuladhar, Namuna College of fashion and design, Dr. Sajana Thapa – Animal Nepal, Sangita Panta, EPSA. President put khada with flower presentation and gave certificate of recognition to four women together with PE, IPP, CP and Past Presidents. President thanked Chair-PP Sushama Sharma and women’s day celebration team of RCK #breakthebias. CP Gajendra B Shrestha was requested to give vote of thanks. President concluded the program by saying “the day when we no longer need to celebrate women’s day is the day we achieve our goal”.

articles.title: RC Kasthamandap Pithouli Electric Cooking and Wheelchairs Distribution
articles.excerpt: With the mission to minimize the use of LPG gas for cooking by electric cooking, RC Kasthamandap visited Pithouli, Nawalparasi for three days service project on 4th to 6th March…
paragraphs: With the mission to minimize the use of LPG gas for cooking by electric cooking, RC Kasthamandap visited Pithouli, Nawalparasi for three days service project on 4th to 6th March 2023.
Pithouli village at Nawalparasi is the adopted village of RC Kasthamandap where a small step but good initiative is started.

Total 24 units of Infrared and 24 units of electric kettle were distributed in Pithouli village. At this stage it may not be enough however we are very happy to start this process aiming at least one small village can be fully LPG gas free and make environment friendly, RCK President Yadab Pradhan said during a distribution ceremony. At the ceremony 15 units of Wheelchairs were also distributed. Stationary, school bags, sports materials and some books were also distributed to the school. President thanked all RCK Members as the required funds were provided by them to procure these items.
The distribution program was held at Pithouli health post where President Yadab, AG Samjhana, PP Gyanendra, Ward Chair of Pithouli, Hospital staff spoke about the program.

articles.title: RC Kasthamandap Pithouli Eye and Dental Camp
articles.excerpt: RC Kasthamandap visited Pithouli, Nawalparasi for three days service project on 4th to 6th March 2023 for various service activities including Eye and Dental services at Pithouli Health post. Pithouli village at Nawalparasi is adopted village of RC Kasthamandap where such…
paragraphs: RC Kasthamandap visited Pithouli, Nawalparasi for three days service project on 4th to 6th March 2023 for various service activities including Eye and Dental services at Pithouli Health post. Pithouli village at Nawalparasi is adopted village of RC Kasthamandap where such services are held annually since more than a decade. Due to Covid and other reasons these services were stopped for several years but this year we are fortunate to be able to come to the village to continue our services President Yadab Pradhan expressed to the gathering of nearly about 90 people besides patients who came to receive services. The program was attended by Assistant Governor Samjhana Pokharel, Ward chair, Hospital management staffs, teachers, students and about 19 Rotarians and Interacts.

Total 154 people received eye checkup and 85 people received glasses. 16 People needed cataract operation. Cost of cataract operation required Rs 7500 each. Bharatpur eye hospital supported Rs 6000 each and needed additional support Rs 1500 each which was supported by RCK members.
Total 71 people received dental checkup and care with the help from Dr. Bimala and team. Cost of medicine for dental checkup were supported by Dr. Bimala herself and PP Gyanendra Lal Pradhan.

The program was organized with the technical support of Bharatpur Eye hospital and Dr. Bimala Pradhan and dental team. President Yadab thanked the hospital, Dr Bimala and her team as well as all Rotarians and expressed great satisfaction for being part of the program which was successfully conducted.

articles.title: RC Kasthamandap Dharan Project
articles.excerpt: RC Kasthamandap has been providing support in Dharan since last 16 years to the disable children and senior citizens. This year also PP Niranjan Bhattarai visited the place to handover some items in Dharan and also in Jhapa on behalf of RC…
paragraphs: RC Kasthamandap has been providing support in Dharan since last 16 years to the disable children and senior citizens. This year also PP Niranjan Bhattarai visited the place to handover some items in Dharan and also in Jhapa on behalf of RC Kasthamandap.

On 9th January 2023 (25th Poush 2079) two wheelchairs to disable as well as blankets, white sticks, senior citizen sticks were distributed to 32 senior citizens in Samajik Bihar, Chatara, Dharan in a program chaired by Prof. Dr. Sanjiv Kumar Sharma, BP Koirala, Health Academy which was attended by about 85 people including members of Samjik Bihar, Jaycees, businessmen and social workers. The cost was approximately Rs. 50,000 which was supported by various RC Kasthamandap members.

Two wheelchairs and 25 blankets were provided to Susta Manasthiti Sasokar at Suranga, Kankai, Jhapa on 7th January 2023 (23rd Poush 2079). The cost was approximately Rs 30,000 which was mainly funded by PP Prabhu Ram Bhandary and PP Niranjan which benefited 28 persons. Mayor of Kankai Nagarpalika Mr. Rajendra Pokharel also attended the distribution program.

articles.excerpt: RC Kasthamandap members have been supporting disabled children at Damravitta village, ward no 3, Itahara Morang since last six years. On 12th Kartik 2079 our Past President Niranjan Bhattarai visited to continue support on behalf of the club to the disables of one family of six…
paragraphs: RC Kasthamandap members have been supporting disabled children at Damravitta village, ward no 3, Itahara Morang since last six years. On 12th Kartik 2079 our Past President Niranjan Bhattarai visited to continue support on behalf of the club to the disables of one family of six members where all five of the family members are disabled except for the mother. The support this year included food items enough for three months and warm clothes that worth total approximately Rs. 50,000. This amount was supported by Rtn Urmila Shrestha, charter member of the club. After the support by RC Kasthamandap six years back, several other people also came to know about the difficulties of this family and they have also started some help to the family. This distribution program was attended by about 12 people. The program was chaired by Puspa Bahadur Karki Ward Chair of Ratuamai Nagarpalika Itahara Morang.

articles.title: Kasthamandap Rotary-Rotaract Tihar Deusi Bhailo Program
articles.excerpt: A fun filled Tihar cultural activities “Deusi Bhailo Program” was organized by Rotaract together with RC Kasthamandap on 23rd October 2022 at the residence of PP Rtn Prabhu Ram Bhandary at Koshi Compound Dillibazar, Kathmandu. The program included various activities like singing…
paragraphs: A fun filled Tihar cultural activities “Deusi Bhailo Program” was organized by Rotaract together with RC Kasthamandap on 23rd October 2022 at the residence of PP Rtn Prabhu Ram Bhandary at Koshi Compound Dillibazar, Kathmandu. The program included various activities like singing songs, deusi bhailo songs, single and group dances as well as magic by Rtr Pratham Oli. Magic show was extra ordinarily appreciated by all participants. President Yadab Pradhan and Rtr President Prabisha gave vote of thanks to PP Prabhu Ram Bhandary and Rtn Rita Bhandary for providing their nice garden for the venue. Presidents also thanked IPP Nepal Bhushan, PP Milan Bikram Shah, VP Dr Manohar, PP Gyanendra, Bhandary families as well as attendance of many Rotaract and their friends around 50. President Yadab appreciated RCK Rotaract for organizing such a wonderful event and said that such event helps in maintaining our cultural heritage and also encourages young people to join Rotaract and Rotary clubs. Program ended with handover of token of love. Cold drinks and snacks were also served. Rotaract also raised some funds for their social programs during the occasion.

pages.title: About Rotary​
pages.text:
Rotary Club Kasthamandap
Club # 56011 | District 3292, Nepal & Bhutan
Solving real problems takes real commitment and vision. For more than 110 years, Rotary’s people of action have used their passion, energy, and intelligence to take action on sustainable projects. From literacy and peace to water and health, we are always working to better our world, and we stay committed to the end.
What we do
Rotary members believe that we have a shared responsibility to take action on our world’s most persistent issues. Our 35,000+ clubs work together to:
Promote peace
Fight disease
Provide clean water, sanitation, and hygiene
Save mothers and children
Support education
Grow local economies
Our mission
We provide service to others, promote integrity, and advance world understanding, goodwill, and peace through our fellowship of business, professional, and community leaders.
We work differently
We see differently:
Our multidisciplinary perspective helps us see challenges in unique ways.
We think differently: We apply leadership and expertise to social issues — and find unique solutions.
We act responsibly: Our passion and perseverance create lasting change.
We make a difference at home and around the world: Our members can be found in your community and across the globe.
Contact Us At:
Purushottam Acharya
Phone: +977-9851050272
Email: purushottam19720417@gmail.com
Alternative Contact :
Yadab Lal Pradhan
Email: yadabpradhan@gmail.com
About Rotaract​
Rotaract Club of Kasthamandap (RACK) is a Non-profit Social Organization chartered on 13th April 2007 for the welfare of society through youth mobilization with a motto of “Fellowship through Service”. RACK is a Rotary-sponsored club for young men and women ages 18 to 30. RACK is sponsored by Rotary Club of Kasthamandap. RACK helps a community through a service project.
Mission
To help the community with an aim of selflessness service through five main avenues, i.e.
Community service
Professional development
Club service
International service Meets at Nepal Association for the Welfare of the Blind (NAWB), Thapathali
Every 1st and 3rd Saturday of English Calendar
